name: Discord
label: Discord — Discord API v10
description: Discord via the official Discord API v10. Base https://discord.com/api/v10. Docs: https://discord.com/developers/docs/reference. Canonical messaging node; social-media.md is discovery only — same folder nodes/discord. Incoming webhooks are send-only (send-webhook). listen = interactions HTTP or gateway events as BPMN message events. Privileged intents required for list-members. No user-token selfbots. Handler: OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). OUTPUT is {status,http_status,data}. Failures raise a BPMN error. Inbound provider events are BPMN message events (operation listen), not a Webhook node.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Discord operation. Set operation plus the fields that operation needs. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"send-message"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official call to run. EXACT values: send-message | send-webhook | get-message | list-messages | delete-message | add-reaction | create-channel | get-channel | list-channels | update-channel | delete-channel | list-members | add-role | remove-role | send-and-wait | listen. listen / send-and-wait are kind:ingress — the handler does not open a socket; use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Example: first verb.

schema.label: channel_id
schema.description: Snowflake channel id. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: message_id
schema.description: Snowflake message id. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: guild_id
schema.description: Snowflake guild id. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: user_id
schema.description: Snowflake user id for role ops. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: role_id
schema.description: Snowflake role id. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: webhook_id
schema.description: Incoming webhook id (send-webhook only). Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: webhook_token
schema.description: Incoming webhook token. Treat as secret if supplied per invoke; prefer config. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: content
schema.description: Message text for send-message / send-webhook. Official Discord `content` (not a generic blob). Max 2000. Example: Hello.

schema.label: emoji
schema.description: URL-encoded emoji for add-reaction (name:id or unicode). Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: embeds
schema.description: Discord embed objects for send-message / send-webhook.

schema.label: sticker_ids
schema.description: Request-body parameter `sticker_ids` for operation: send-message.

schema.label: message_reference
schema.description: send-message reply reference {message_id, channel_id, guild_id, fail_if_not_exists}.

schema.label: username
schema.description: Request-body parameter `username` for operation: send-webhook.

schema.label: avatar_url
schema.description: Request-body parameter `avatar_url` for operation: send-webhook.

schema.label: around
schema.description: Query-string parameter `around` for operation: list-messages.

schema.label: before
schema.description: Query-string parameter `before` for operation: list-messages.

schema.label: after
schema.description: Query-string parameter `after` for operations: list-messages, list-members.

schema.label: limit
schema.description: Query-string parameter `limit` for operations: list-messages, list-members.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Request-body parameter `name` for operations: create-channel, update-channel. Required by: create-channel.

schema.label: type
schema.description: Request-body parameter `type` for operation: create-channel.

schema.label: parent_id
schema.description: Request-body parameter `parent_id` for operations: create-channel, update-channel.

schema.label: topic
schema.description: Request-body parameter `topic` for operations: create-channel, update-channel.

schema.label: tts
schema.description: send-message / send-webhook tts.

schema.label: flags
schema.description: send-message flags bitfield (e.g. 4096 suppress notifications).

schema.label: nonce
schema.description: send-message nonce for idempotency.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result object. Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Ingress operations return a message telling the operator to use a BPMN message event. Secrets never appear. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP success. EXACT: ok.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream HTTP status. Example: 200.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the provider, or raw text if not JSON. Never contains secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when INPUT omits operation. EXACT: send-message, send-webhook, get-message, list-messages, delete-message, add-reaction, create-channel, get-channel, list-channels, update-channel, delete-channel, list-members, add-role, remove-role, send-and-wait, listen. listen/send-and-wait instruct the operator to use BPMN message events.

configurationParameters.label: Bot token
configurationParameters.description: Discord bot token. Sent as Authorization: Bot <token>. StudioQuack secret. Never a user/selfbot token. Never log. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for each official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Default 25. 0/blank → 25.
